decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No importation of the material for the bunding shall take place until details of an import specification criteria including the determinants to be tested and the concentrations to be achieved, and results of testing, and any quality assurance required, shall be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and carried out as approved. The material must be from a natural source or be a product quality assured as suitable for use as subsoil or, if placed within 250mm of the finished surface level, as topsoil in accordance with BS3882: 2007. The material should have no visual or olfactory signs of hydrocarbon contamination and should not contain physically deleterious material (for example plastics or rubble).  It should be chemically tested at the rate of one sample per 100 metres cubed including a minimum of two samples of topsoil to confirm the material's suitability. Testing parameters should include speciated petroleum hydrocarbons, polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons, and metals and metalloids.

Condition : 4 - Details of replacement planting along the south and west boundaries of the site, in order to compensate for the loss of the existing planting as a result of the works, shall be submitted for approval.  The approved details shall be carried out within three months of the completion of the approved works.
Condition : 5 - The close boarded fence and palisade fence along the west boundary of the site, adjoining No 2 Wesley Avenue, shall both be installed at the same time and permanently retained.
description: Construction of an earth bund along the southern boundary and replacement fencing along the southern and western boundaries of the playground to create flood mitigation works.
